title: docs(adr): rewrite ADR-0146 as the package-level override record — paired `<base>.custom`, one declared override shared by code and Studio; dated pointers on six Status lines
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DUA7RHH6LE2bbZbMvczDLPh)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czTS5hqnBm8k5vxKq9

Fixes #28237

Part of #28236

Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** ADR-0146 原地改写为「包级覆盖」记录：已安装软件包（如 HotCRM）的一切定制——改原有的、加新的、扩展对象——都进配对的可写包 `<base>.custom`；「改原有的」= 在 `.custom` 同名项正文里显式声明 `overrides: { package, basedOn }`，整份替换；写代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制随包导出、进 git、跨环境部署。D1/D5/D6/D7 的 Studio／Setup 边界保留，「Studio 项工具栏」（N-05）排在所有定制卡之前。
- **为什么改：** 10-30 走查的四个问题（Studio 改不了只读包；Setup 写的是不随包走的无包覆盖行；克隆即双跑；依赖包的同名视图静默盖掉基础包）在一条规则下一起关闭。您 10-30／10-31 的裁定逐条原文引用，八个拍板问题各落在对应决定里。
- **推翻了什么：** 七条旧条款——ADR-0126 D1 与 D4 墙 1、ADR-0131 D6、ADR-0005 五型、ADR-0048 §3.3、ADR-0009 的恢复读法、ADR-0141 D3 卸载项——在「取代表」里逐条原文引用，并写明各自改动的门与钉测试（`path#symbol` 锚点，门禁全部可解析）。六份记录只在 Status 行加带日期的指针，正文一字未动。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 `docs/adr/`（ADR-0146、六条 Status 行、重新生成的 README），不含代码、不含 changeset；一切机制都是 epic #28236 合并后再切卡。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** ADR-0146 末尾「Decided here where the rulings were silent」七条——合并即接受，反对请点编号。其中两条是我补的空白：配对包的依赖范围取基础包的大版本（`^major`）；卸载拒绝沿用 `uninstallPackage` 现有的 409 形状。
- **需要您做的：** 契约复审由席位出具（尚未出具）；本记录为 Tier H，需您亲手合并。PR 保持 draft，不会自动 ready／arm／merge。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0146-…paired-customize-package.md` — rewritten in place as the package-level override record (N-01 of epic #28236). D1, D5, D6, D7 of the 2026-10-30 draft stand; D2 (in-place overlay editing) and D3 (`<base>.customize`) are replaced by the declared override and the paired `<base>.custom` package; D4 keeps the ledger switch and reduces clone to "new similar"; D8 (one effective read), D9 (flows: served over the code package, rebound in one reload, ledger identity inherited, real version pinning first), D10 (`__c` extension fields reserved to `.custom`, display-property whitelist) and D11 (migrate package-less overlay rows, then close the write; retire the stopgaps) are new. A supersede table quotes each superseded clause verbatim and names the gate and pin test that change, as `path#symbol` anchors. The eight agreed questions are tabled. Rollout follows the epic's N-numbered plan, item toolbar first.
- PR #28145's S13–S15 are folded: the four load-bearing symbols are anchored (`deriveNamespaceFromPackageId`, `refuseUngrantedActivationWrite`, `useTenancyPosture`, `walledCatalogReadOnly` with its posture-and-rung caveat), D7 counts the two Setup pages and places queue membership under ADR-0142, and the Rollout opener carries no label snapshot.
- Status lines of ADR-0005, 0009, 0048, 0126, 0131 and 0141 — one dated pointer each, `· **Superseded in part by [ADR-0146](…)** (2026-10-31) — CLAUSE`, in ADR-0005's amendment style. Nothing else in those records changes (Prime Directive #13). ADR-0048 and ADR-0141 had a wrapped Status paragraph; it is joined onto one physical line so `scripts/adr-index.mjs` reads the pointer (words unchanged).
- `docs/adr/README.md` — regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs`: ADR-0146 reads Accepted with its six "Supersedes" refs; the six records gain "Superseded by: ADR-0146".

## Why

Maintainer rulings of 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-31 on epic #28236, verbatim in the record: 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 · 「同意 后缀改成 .custom」 · 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」 · 「扩展字段用 __c 后缀，只有 .custom 包能用。」 · 「adr 146还没开始开发，可以直接改」. The 2026-10-30 walkthrough measured the four defects the record's Context lists (#28238, #28148, #28149 at `d6c0a75f1a`).

## Verification

| Check | Base (`origin/main` 69ce01d7) | Head |
|---|---|---|
| `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` | OK | OK (README regenerated and committed) |
| `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` | 944 link destinations resolve | 959 resolve |
| `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` | 2852 anchors / 148 records (632 symbol: 604 declaration, 28 literal; 2173 file-level) | 2930 anchors / 148 records (673 symbol: 645 declaration, 28 literal; 2210 file-level) |

Every quote in the record was re-checked against its source: the epic body and checklist comment, #28148, the six superseded records (each superseded clause is a verbatim substring of its record) and the 2026-10-30 draft's row rulings.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived the gate families for this change set; each was run in a fresh worktree after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, exit codes recorded and reconciled with `--ran` (see the report in the project files). All 21 derived families ran to exit 0 and `--ran` reconciles 21 of 21, before and after the commit (the `check:doc-formula-expressions` gate first exited 3 — prerequisite, the `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` workspace packages not built — and ran to 0 after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`).

No code, no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Human Minimum

- [ ] The Status line of ADR-0146 reads as the acceptance you intend; the hand-merge is the acceptance act.
- [ ] Each of the seven superseded clauses in the supersede table is the clause you meant to supersede, and no more.

- [ ] The seven "Decided here where the rulings were silent" items are acceptable, or an objection names the number.
- [ ] D2's type list ("at least …; the spec card closes it") is the intended scope.
- [ ] D9 item 4: flow customization waits for real version pinning (N-12) with no interim publish gate, as ruled.
- [ ] The Rollout's N-numbers match epic #28236's plan of record.
- [ ] Contract review by the skills seat is recorded before the governed approvers are requested.
